# Music credits

Scene BGM is CC0 (public domain) from [OpenGameArt.org](https://opengameart.org/). No attribution is required; listed so we remember the source.

| File | Use | Author | Page |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title.ogg` | Title | Kosmo The Cat | [Calm and simple title music](https://opengameart.org/content/calm-and-simple-title-music) |
| `town.mp3` | Town | troubadour | [Fantasy Song Pack Volume 1](https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-song-pack-volume-1) (`homestead.mp3`) |
| `crypt.mp3` | Crypt | troubadour | same pack (`wandering_woodlands.mp3`) |
| `cave.mp3` | Cave | troubadour | same pack (`back_to_nature.mp3`) |
| `castle.mp3` | Castle | troubadour | same pack (`jaunt.mp3`) |
| `boss.mp3` | Boss / elite aggro | iamoneabe | [RPG Battle Loop](https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-battle-loop) |

If a download is missing, the baker falls back to The Sound Guild loops in the Complete RPG Creator Bundle (`Dark_Fantasy_01/02`, `Magic_Ethereal_Aura`, dungeon/forest ambience).

Run `python3 tools/fetch_music.py` (also invoked from the baker).
